# Greenhouse Harvest

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — lets recruiters and HR teams query their Greenhouse Harvest applicant tracking system in plain language: look up candidates, check application statuses, list scheduled interviews, and pull pipeline metrics, through a Membrane integration. Note: despite the name, this is about the Greenhouse *Harvest* recruiting software, not actual greenhouses. by @membranedev, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: you need a paid Greenhouse Harvest account (no usable free tier) plus a free Membrane account, and you must install the Membrane CLI with npm. The SKILL.md reads partly like an integration template — some sections are generic placeholders rather than Greenhouse-specific guidance — so review the setup steps carefully before use. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
